environment.description: Same application deployed identically on EC2 behind ALB, but the ALB has an associated AWS WAF WebACL. The WebACL contains two rule groups evaluated in order: (1) a custom rule group 'uri-rate-limiter' with priority 0 that applies a rate-based rule of 100 requests per 5 minutes scoped to IP, with action BLOCK — this is intended for DDoS mitigation and does NOT inspect request content; (2) AWS managed rule group 'AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet' at priority 1 with all rules in COUNT mode except 'SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING' which is in BLOCK mode with a custom response code 403. The SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule blocks any request where the query string exceeds 2048 bytes. Additionally, the application's gunicorn configuration sets --limit-request-line 4094. The SQLite database is on an EBS volume with encryption at rest (aws:kms). CloudWatch alarms trigger on 4xx rate > 5% over 1 minute.
